sources.entry: REDAXO - Simple, flexible and useful content management system (documentation in German). (Source Code) MIT PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: REDAXO is an open-source, MIT-licensed PHP content management system and website framework, mainly used in German-speaking countries, that lets you build content from custom modules.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes REDAXO as a simple yet flexible CMS and website framework that has been in development since 2004. It lets you create content from custom modules with full control over input and output. The software is multilingual and extendable through addons, and the README says it adapts to different workflows. The README points to a built-in Installer addOn for trying out demo websites (Base, Community, OnePage, FullPage), with the Base demo fully translated into English. For core development, it describes cloning the repository, running Composer install, and starting a local environment with docker-compose.
use_cases: build a website with custom content modules
create a simple PHP CMS for German-language sites
develop REDAXO core or addons locally
evaluate a PHP website framework with demo sites
notable: Content built from custom modules with full control of input and output
Multilingual; the README lists English, Spanish, Italian, Swedish and Portuguese translations
Built-in Installer addOn to set up demo websites
Active community with a Slack chat and a community world map
caveats: Documentation and community are mainly in German; the README notes the Base demo is the English-translated starting point
Development setup relies on Composer and Docker; the README gives no other platform details
